complete.title: Core Platform Launch
details: STO Info is live as a free, community-run app.
Core STO account and character tracking is available.
Platform monitoring added.
Contact and team pages were added.
The visual direction was created using a LCARS-inspired interface.

complete.title: Dashboard Insights
details: Character statistics and filtering were introduced on the dashboard.

complete.title: Endeavour Tracking
details: A dedicated Endeavour Perks dashboard was added.
Account management now includes Endeavour progress and related improvements.

complete.title: News, Banners and Notifications
details: A dedicated news, banners and notifications system was added.
Users can now receive updates and alerts about important events.
Release notes and announcements are now available in-app.

complete.title: Reputation Tracking
details: Character reputation tracking was added for all thirteen reputations.
Tier progress (up to Tier 6) can be tracked per character.
A reputation summary shows overall completion at a glance.

complete.title: Character Progression
details: Research & Development tracking.
Captain Specialization tracking.
Other character progress improvements.

complete.title: Community Info Sharing
details: The Galactic Personnel Registry is now available for public community profile sharing.
Friendships and user blocking were added across the platform.
Member reporting and admin moderation tools for the community area.

complete.title: Storytime and Custom Tracking
details: STO Storytime: publish, discover, and track community-created Star Trek Online stories, chapters, characters, and arcs (an out-of-game Foundry).
Custom account and character tracking options.

complete.title: Fleet Communities
details: Characters now record the Fleet they are in.
Fleet Communities, Fleets and Armadas can be registered, found in the Fleet Directory and run through roles, recruitment and holdings.
Fleet roster management was added, with imports, history, reports, news, events and notifications.
Chat was added for Fleet, Armada and Community channels and between friends.
Improved the LCARS interface look and feel throughout the app.
Captain's and Personal Logs.
Email notifications can be switched on for each kind of notice, sent instantly or in a daily or weekly digest.
News posts can now have cover images.
Storytime is out of beta: creators can reorder Chapters, copy Characters between their Stories and hide spoilers in comments.
Volunteer testers are now credited on the About Us page.

planned: Expanded account and character insight views.
More quality-of-life improvements across management workflows.
